knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The roof customer buys a cleaned roof surface with the roof areas named, a readable method and stated limits. The hourly rate and equipment are inputs.
A guarantee must be something you can deliver and afford, or it damages the business. A fix-first promise you can keep is the lesson's model.
A measurable or result claim must be substantiated by evidence that supports it. The lesson says not to state a result you have not seen.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
